Article 10.1: How to Contact FFN Support

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule
Support Channels
Channel	Contact / Link	Best For
Email support	support@fundedfuturesnetwork.com	Payout requests, BOGO questions, account issues, formal inquiries
Live chat	Chat widget on fundedfuturesnetwork.com	Quick questions: avg. 10-second response from a real person
Discord	discord.gg/T5GpWm7cF8	Community support, daily reset discounts, news and announcements
Risk manager	FFN Dashboard → Risk Manager Request form	Promotion Review questions, contract limit questions, strategy guidance

For the fastest support, use the chat on our website. For after hours support, open a ticket in our Discord.

What to Include When Emailing Support
Your full name and dashboard username
Account number (starts with 7PV) if the issue is account-specific
A clear description of the issue or request
Screenshots if applicable
Onboarding Calls

FFN offers personalized onboarding calls for new traders. During the call, a support team member will walk you through the platform, explain the rules, and make sure you are set up correctly. To schedule, check the email titled "Important please read" you received when you signed up with FFN.
